runtime_boundary: Official fixed-menu references are analysis-only. Runtime icons are C/C++ byte arrays in EchoPetMenuIconResources.cpp.
policy: The EchoPet side rails model the external fixed menu icon semantics, so compact 24x24 and large 30x30 icons are derived from the same official device/menu tile per slot.
